comment: Standard deals for accelerator programmes (issue #533, from the 2026-11-25 crawler self-critique: accelerator participation was recorded as an edge, never a transaction). Each entry records one programme's published standard deal so cohort participation can later be converted into funding rounds (issue #534). A programme whose standard deal has not been sourced from its official pages is recorded with deal_status 'unknown' and a null deal — never estimated. Amounts keep their original currency; amount_usd uses the committed fallback rate in data/fx-rates.json, with the rate and its date recorded on the deal. Validated by scripts/accelerator_deals.py and tests/test_accelerator_deals.py.

components.terms: Converts into a fixed 7% of the company in the priced round.
Converts on the terms of the lowest-cap SAFE (or other most favourable terms) issued between the MFN start date and the priced round.

deal.terms: Standard deal for every company accepted to Y Combinator, committed on the day of acceptance and not contingent on milestones; no programme fees. Made as two SAFEs at the same time with an accompanying YC Agreement, including a participation (pro-rata) right in the company's future financing rounds.

deals.name: Y Combinator
deals.source_name: Y Combinator — The YC Standard Deal

deal.instrument: SAFE or priced equity round (founder's choice)
deal.terms: AUD $120,000 invested in every accepted company; no programme fees. Founders who have not previously raised are invested on a post-money SAFE at a AUD $1.5M post-money valuation cap (8% of the company). Founders who have raised AUD $250,000 or more from VC or angel investors, finalised with executed documents before interviews, have the terms and valuation of that round matched instead (equity take then below 8%, so equity_percent and valuation_cap describe the not-previously-raised case). Founders choose whether Startmate invests via its template SAFE or into their priced equity round.
